correctness.rationale: For all n>=9 the only graph triangles are the n consecutive triples; edge/triple inclusion-exclusion gives f2=n(2n-9), and double-counting four-runs gives f3=n(n-4). The three stage free triangular face pairings remove exactly n(n-7)+2n+n=f3 tetrahedra; n>=9 prevents congruence collisions. Because all original edges exist and the two-faces containing spanning-tree edges allow fan reduction, pi1 vanishes. After the elementary collapses the complex is two-dimensional with no C3; the rank of d2 is binom(n-1,2), yielding integral H2=Z^((n^2-7n-2)/2). Hurewicz plus homological Whitehead yields the claimed wedge. Exact executable checks verify stages at n=9..30 and separate mod-2 d3 ranks n=9..16, but the infinite conclusion rests on the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The natural filled clique complex of a squared cycle is nonchordal and lies outside the chordal collapsibility theorems motivating the question. A sharp, entirely integral homotopy classification for every n>=9 is new information beyond Leray bounds, finite computations, or a single exceptional case. Its explicit cyclic free-face matching exposes the topological mechanism and the quadratic two-sphere count; the n-11 Betti-rank contrast with squared paths is a structural boundary effect, not a made-up parameter slice.
